# WY Console

WY Console applies an 80s sci-fi computer console aesthetic to Obsidian with matched dark and light modes. It styles panels, menus and buttons, and its recorded description names support for the Advanced Tables, Kanban, Calendar and File Tree Alternative community plugins.

![WY Console screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/satchelmouth/Obsidian-Theme-WYConsole/HEAD/WYConsole_Store_Screenshot.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "WY Console"
    author: "satchelmouth"
    repo:   "satchelmouth/Obsidian-Theme-WYConsole"
    slug:   "wy-console"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/wy-console"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/satchelmouth/Obsidian-Theme-WYConsole"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/satchelmouth/Obsidian-Theme-WYConsole/HEAD/WYConsole_Store_Screenshot.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Apply an 80s sci-fi computer console aesthetic to Obsidian with matched dark and light modes. Style panels, menus, buttons, and support popular community plugins like Advanced Tables, Kanban, Calendar, and File Tree Alternative."
}
```
